source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary:
Use it in either player's Fight phase, right after an enemy unit selects its targets. Pick 1 of your **ADEPTUS ASTARTES** units it targeted. Until the phase ends, whenever a model of that unit is **destroyed** before it has fought this phase, the model:

1. stays on the battlefield
2. may fight, but only after the attacking unit is done attacking
3. is removed afterwards

window.timing: just after an enemy unit has selected its targets

effects.trigger: a model in your unit is destroyed
effects.condition: that model has not fought this phase
effects.then: it can fight after the attacking unit has finished its attacks, then it is removed from play

cardPrintsOtherText.name: A Worthy Death
cardPrintsOtherText.trigger: an enemy unit targets that unit
cardPrintsOtherText.condition: your unit has yet to be chosen to fight this phase
cardPrintsOtherText.removal: when your unit has fought or the phase ends, whichever comes first
